bagPolicy.summary: Small purses and fanny packs up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches are allowed and searched; backpacks, drawstring bags and larger purses are prohibited.
allowed: Small purse or fanny pack up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Event parking is available off Prospect Avenue, East 46th Street and Euclid Avenue; prices vary by event. The venue also sells advance passes.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Agora FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue is cashless at its bars and ticket windows; outside food, drinks and alcohol are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Contact boxoffice@agoracleveland.com reasonably ahead of the event to request an accessible arrangement.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is permitted; there is a designated smoking area outside for guests who need it.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are at the windows near the front entrance; show photo ID or the card used to pay. Normal box office hours are Tuesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–6 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The ticket windows are by the front entrance; bag checks apply at entry. The show listing supplies the door time.
